Hospital Connect map sources

BC outline: Statistics Canada, via geoBoundaries gbOpen CAN ADM1.
Source metadata: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/CAN/ADM1/
Pinned source: https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/tree/41af8f1/releaseData/gbOpen/CAN/ADM1
Source licence: Open Government Licence - Canada 2.0 / Statistics Canada Open Licence Agreement.
https://open.canada.ca/en/open-government-licence-canada
https://www.statcan.gc.ca/eng/reference/licence
Modified for this app: British Columbia extracted, properties reduced, polygon coordinates simplified to approximately 0.008 degrees and rounded. This is an illustrative geographic outline, not an official survey or navigation boundary. No endorsement is implied.

Optional street tiles: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
Tile requests contain map coordinates, not patient/case data. They can be disabled on the map.

Hospital names, locations, resources, contacts and availability: the existing invented Hospital Connect demonstration fixtures. They are not real hospital locations or verified live capacity. No road travel times or ambulance instructions are provided.
